name: Tech Stack Detection
content:
Identify the complete technology stack of {url}.

Elements to identify :
1. Web server (Apache, Nginx, IIS)
2. Backend language (PHP, Python, Java, Node.js)
3. Framework (Laravel, Django, Spring, Express)
4. CMS (WordPress, Drupal, Joomla)
5. Frontend (React, Vue, Angular)
6. Likely database
7. CDN and WAF
8. Third-party services (analytics, APIs)

Commands :
```bash
whatweb {url}
httpx -u {url} -title -status-code -tech-detect -server
curl -I {url}
```

Suggest vulnerabilities specific to this stack.
